metadata.notes: Integration-authored PLAYER questions paired with unchanged existing NPC reputation-question responses. Exact adult_question option identity is required; Greet and other options must not consume these rows. No new NPC wording, menu options, cameras, quests, actions or conversion credit. First/familiar reflects actual contact snapshot only; the player questions claim no prior meeting, help, stories, deeds, residence, travel or access permission.
metadata.intent_rule: Current-social-regard responses receive current-regard questions. Advisory responses receive prospective social-advice questions. Per-line intent is recorded below; metaphors never authorize a world action or establish biography.

variant_inventory.npc_text: We will see what kind of neighbor you choose to be.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Do right by people, and they will notice. Do wrong, and they will notice faster.

variant_inventory.npc_text: For now, you are someone passing through. What comes next is up to you.

variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You have neither earned trust nor given us a reason to close the gates.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Most villagers will judge your next choice for what it is.

variant_inventory.npc_text: People know your face, but not your character yet.
variant_inventory.reason: Recognition by others is not established by reputation or this contact snapshot.

variant_inventory.npc_text: No one expects trouble from you, though no one assumes loyalty either.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You stand at the easiest point to shape your reputation.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Respect is useful. Be careful not to spend it carelessly.

variant_inventory.npc_text: People weigh your words because your actions gave them reason to.

variant_inventory.npc_text: A good name is a tool. Use it carefully.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: People here expect more from you now, because you have shown you can give it.
variant_inventory.reason: Previously demonstrated capacity to give.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Respect makes doors easier to open, but it also makes mistakes louder.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You are trusted enough that your choices reach farther than you may think.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: The village has seen enough from you to listen first.
variant_inventory.reason: Village previously observed enough conduct.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Keep walking the way that earned this respect, and it will hold.
variant_inventory.reason: Previously demonstrated behavioral path.

variant_inventory.npc_text: People listen when you offer an opinion.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You have shown enough good judgment to earn a fair hearing.
variant_inventory.reason: Previously demonstrated good judgment.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Neighbors trust you with work they would not give a stranger.
variant_inventory.reason: Entrusted work implies an unsupported work relationship.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Your help has been noticed beyond the people who received it.
variant_inventory.reason: Actual help received and noticed beyond recipients.

variant_inventory.npc_text: The village expects you to keep acting with care.
variant_inventory.reason: Keep acting with care presupposes prior careful conduct.

variant_inventory.npc_text: A few doors open faster when people know it is you.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.
variant_inventory.figurative_limit: Faster opening doors describes social regard only, not actual entry permission, locks or housing access.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Your name comes up kindly around the workstations.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Respect makes mistakes easier to discuss, not easier to ignore.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: People have begun asking whether you will stay longer.
variant_inventory.reason: Longer stay implies duration and a specific conversation.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You are no longer just another traveler passing through.
variant_inventory.reason: Prior traveler status and transition.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Some players pass through villages like weather. You left roots.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.
variant_inventory.figurative_limit: Roots describes current social belonging only, not literal settlement, residence or travel history.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You made yourself part of the village instead of passing through it.
variant_inventory.reason: Travel or residence history implied by becoming part of village rather than passing through.

variant_inventory.npc_text: People speak of you like someone whose footsteps belong here.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Your help has settled into the village like a well-built wall.
variant_inventory.reason: Previous help.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You are remembered here for more than one good deed.
variant_inventory.reason: More than one good deed.

variant_inventory.npc_text: The village does not give that kind of regard lightly.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You have become part of the stories people use to feel safer.
variant_inventory.reason: Specific stories used for reassurance.

variant_inventory.npc_text: When your name comes up, most faces soften before anyone says why.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You have done enough good here that people measure others against it.
variant_inventory.reason: Prior good deeds.

variant_inventory.npc_text: A village knows the difference between a visitor and someone who stayed in the ways that matter.
variant_inventory.reason: Prior staying.

variant_inventory.npc_text: People tell stories about what you have done for us.
variant_inventory.reason: Stories about deeds for village.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Your name makes frightened villagers feel steadier.
variant_inventory.reason: Actually frightened villagers and their emotional response are additional unguarded state.

variant_inventory.npc_text: The village remembers every time you chose to help.
variant_inventory.reason: Remembered help episodes.

variant_inventory.npc_text: You have earned a welcome at nearly every door.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.
variant_inventory.figurative_limit: Welcome at doors describes social regard only, not actual entry permission, locks or housing access.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Neighbors ask what you would do when trouble starts.
variant_inventory.reason: Neighbors consulting player example during trouble.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Children try to copy the brave parts of your stories.
variant_inventory.reason: Children imitating previously told stories.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Your word can settle doubts that mine cannot.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Respect like this was built one choice at a time.
variant_inventory.reason: Particular cumulative history of choices.

variant_inventory.npc_text: People save a place for you at important gatherings.
variant_inventory.reason: Reserved places at important gatherings.

variant_inventory.npc_text: Even the cautious villagers speak well of you.
variant_inventory.reason: Current social regard or prospective social advice fits an actual reputation-only owner without assuming a prior deed, meeting or event.
